answer: One concrete resistance is rotating attestation quorums driven by an unpredictable random beacon. Like a comet, the beacon seed is unknown until it appears, so no clone farm can pre-book which committee will judge its identities. Each epoch every agent is re-sorted into a fresh quorum, and the old fable of buying one permanent committee collapses: an attacker must bribe a newly sampled, uncorrelated quorum every single round. Near-miss votes land in a ferrous audit log, so repeated collusion across rounds raises a cluster flag that freezes the whole batch pending review.
